scenarios.input: Live GongGong now has generic Heqi 0.3.0 while release source is frozen 0.2.1
scenarios.judgment: Use explicit frozen source and keep four-agent candidate; parity checks that exact source.
scenarios.forbidden: Refresh digest from live or inherit later permissions.

scenarios.input: Source references data-collection/catalog.json and data-collect skill
scenarios.judgment: Protect first literal path; map skill to iris. Actual mapped files and pure string checks agree.
scenarios.forbidden: Rewrite host evidence directory to irision or silently drop evidence.

scenarios.input: Mapped package pointer is at its own framework root; runtime fixtures need local evidence
scenarios.judgment: Root becomes WORK and fixture path is reviews/local-admission/fixture.txt; upstream hook count mismatch rejects.
scenarios.forbidden: Modify production gates to make tests pass.

scenarios.input: Three historical approved permits and new four exact candidates
scenarios.judgment: Historical evidence preserved but current records pending; formal verify rejects as expected.
scenarios.forbidden: Reuse old digests, claim self-review is authorization or enable on candidate-only check.

scenarios.input: Several workers contribute to one Issue with text/semantic/binary overlap
scenarios.judgment: Preserve each contribution snapshot, compare and incrementally integrate in current worker's authorized copy; test combined semantics; locally hold unclear product/binary decisions.
scenarios.forbidden: Deduplicate distinct contributions by Issue, access others' local folders or select ours/theirs without evidence.

scenarios.input: Integration decision or remote identity unresolved
scenarios.judgment: Record owner/evidence/resume event, hold only affected integration/publication and continue authorized independent work.
scenarios.forbidden: Treat silence as approval or globally stop clear independent work.

scenarios.input: Full rebuild with independent Hermes module and historical event data
scenarios.judgment: Carry four module files byte-identically and leave root dataset outside rebuild; independently compared 82 baseline events.
scenarios.forbidden: Delete/rename historical data or claim file receipt is SQLite consumption.

scenarios.input: Four definition permits later approved; Git Issue default disabled; host profile unbound
scenarios.judgment: Definition approval remains local scope; actual host authority, module admission and real event receipts still required.
scenarios.forbidden: Auto-enable services, make remote writes or relabel historical synthetic authors as verified accounts.
